Ongar Road is a prime residential street within striking distance of West Brompton and Fulham Broadway. Earls Court and the local amenities of Old Brompton Road are a short walk away. The property boasts an excellent location with numerous boutiques, restaurants and bars in the area. This apartment is an exceptional example of modern Fulham living, combining thoughtful design with a sought-after location. It presents a superb opportunity for tenants looking for a stylish and functional home with the added benefit of private outdoor space.
